Sent: 2/27/2024 3:26 PM
Subject: Oak Ridge Capital

Oak Ridge Capital has gotten back to me and is undecided on what they want to do with the Elmwood portfolio assets. In particular, they haven't settled on how to handle the digital asset holdings, dislike the current digital documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the assets once they decide how to proceed. So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Granite financial holdings and master agreement sit.
</quoted>
